card.name: The digit 1 starting a number
card.fires_on: The digit 1 as the first digit of a multi-digit number, such as a street address, a decimal like 1.6, or 1.73 m2. Also seen on 'caus' + 'ative' in 'other causative factors'.

modes.label: Leading digit 1
modes.description: The digit 1 opens a number, often with more digits following, in addresses, formulas or units.

modes.label: Causative factors
modes.description: The ending 'ative' of 'causative' in 'absence of other causative factors' in warning text.
